title: Shwetank Sharma from S&R joins JSA as Partner in the Capital Markets practice
description: S&R Associates Counsel Shwetank Sharma has joined JSA Advocates & Solicitors as a Partner in Capital Markets practice in New Delhi.Sharma is a 2018 graduate of Amity Law School, Noida.He has over eight years of experience advising issuers, merchant bankers and investors across a broad range of equity and debt capital markets transactions.
